notes.title: Patch V0.6.6
notes.content:
[h1]Changes[/h1]
- World 1 First Half can now only drop a maximum of Grade 1 Guns.
- World 1 Second Half can now only drop a maximum of Grade 2 Guns.
- Shops can still sell +1 level of Grade, however the price has been increased from 60 to 75.
- Chip Shops +1 Level of Grade has been reduced from 75 to 60.
[b]Dev Note:[/b] There was far too much power coming from weapons early on and there was a Meta built around pushing for Grade 5 weapons before Logan which was a huge power boost. This will bring it more in line and make it more controllable. This also means that skipping on Weapon Chests/Shops is okay as they upgrade as you progress.
- Weapon Grade bonus damage changed from +10 to 25% per Grade.
- Double Tap PPM from 2PPM -> 6PPM at Base.
[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed an issue where you could buy items when unpausing the game on controller.
- Spinners should no longer go through walls. (I hope)
- Laser turrets shouldn't have weird clipping on some levels now.
- Pausing during the countdown doesn't un-pause the game now.
- Swapping weapons shouldn't cause a muzzle flash anymore.
[h1]Known Bugs[/h1]
- Score is sometimes showing as 23,000 in some rooms. Added debugging to help track down the issue.
- Unable to continue your run on your first ever run.
- Completing a room too fast might cause the room to not complete. You can return to hub and continue run to fix this.
- Race Rooms may always reward you with an "S" Score.
- Doing an infinite run that goes on a very long time could cause issues with Chips and chests.

notes.title: Patch V0.6.4
notes.content:
Hey folks! Decent size patch here. Some of the main things I wanted to focus on this patch is difficulty, along with how Onboarding + Progression works. You'll notice a few balance changes listed below, along with some bug fixes. I still have a lot on my plate, however I wanted to get this patch out there today before Thursday.

[b]If you are willing to, please delete your save file.[/b] I'd love to get some feedback on how progression feels, especially on players who have yet to complete the Data Disc first boss.
[i]I could have forced this...[/i]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
- Infinite Scaling buffed by 200%.
- Easy mode no longer reduces the HP of an enemy.
- Hard mode no longer increases the HP of an enemy.
	[b]Dev Note:[/b] Players felt easy was too easy and hard enemies were too spongey. Trying this out to get a feel for things along with trying to figure out what the average duration of a run is.

- Rebalanced augments cost + augment capacity.
- Increased damage gained by X Attack from 5% -> 10%
- Made all Augments equip capacity to 1.
	[b]Dev Note:[/b] I'd like to encourage players to pickup some early power to help push them through the first boss sooner. While the "Increase in Cost" may seem weird, the amount of credit rooms needed to unlock them should equal out and help power progression be smoother moving into later worlds.

- In order to help onboarding, introduced a "Forced Credits" single choice room.
- Quick Draw Damage changed from 40 -> 30
- Smart Pistol Damage changed from 75 -> 60 (Or 25 -> 20 Per Shot)
- Shock Status Effect bonus Damage changed from 20% -> 10%.
- Opening Shot additional tiers difference changed from 5% -> 10%
- Execute additional tiers difference changed from 5% -> 10%
- Changed explosive barrels to be hit based instead of HP based. Now require 3 hits to activate.
- Reduced explosive barrels cook time from 3s -> 2s
- Updates to Chip and Augment Descriptions
- Changed default emote buttons to other side of Number Row.
- Added Ultimate Icon to tutorial to help explain it better.
- Can now click on Ultimate Description Box to open the Window.
- Warning Laser made more obvious.
- Greyed out Loadout button instead of hiding it, to indicate that there is something there.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed Shatter never getting upgraded.
- Augments that now "Start" you with something should now properly "Start" you with that something.
- Fixed a shop bug that allowed you to buy the same weapon multiple times, which would cause your game to crash.
- Filled a hole in A7
- Shield Generators shouldn't be able to be hit a floor above anymore.

[h1]Known Bugs[/h1]
- Some enemies are hittable from a floor above.
- Smart Pistol may still hit some enemies a floor above.
- Spinners can sometimes go through walls.
- Getting first place in a Race Room may always score you with an "S".
- Doing an infinite run that goes on a very long time could cause issues with Chips and chests.
- Score might be getting calculated weird in some cases causing you to go over the maximum expected score during a Normal Run.

- Wide Screen Monitor's not fully supported.
- Spinners will sometimes go off the map/through walls. If this happens you can Return to Menu (NOT Restart Run) and then Continue Run to be able to continue your run in the same room.

notes.title: Patch V0.2.4
notes.content:
[h1]Patch V0.2.4[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
- Weapon Grades
- Weapons will now have a Grade attached to them similar to Chips.
- You will always find a weapon at the same Grade as your highest, or plus one if you have two at the same grade.

[b]Developer Note:[/b] This is a feature we wanted to get in pre-playtest however didn't have the time for. Currently, the only weapon stat that increases is Damage. However in the future we will add bonus perks, like the Charger having more charge stages, or The Zipper having more bounces and so forth.

[h2]Changes[/h2]
- Miniboss now appears on Room 8 - Down from 10.
- Boss now appears on Room 16 - Down from 20
- AS-2 Minor Nerf

[b]Developer Note:[/b] Overall I feel the pacing was off/too long. I was originally developing with the mindset of "Just World 1", however we're going to have more worlds in the future. As such I wanted to reduce the pacing, while also "nerfing" the player a bit in terms of power (EG: Less Rooms means Less Currency and Less Chips.) The introduction of weapon grades should help balance out the power and give the player something new to chase.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Current Runs that are corrupt due to an update will no longer be able to be continued.
- Augment Tutorial being blocked if you unlocked Infinite Run before completing the tutorial.
- Not being able to select Infinite Run on controller.
- Standing on top of some shadows.
- Lasers playing after UFO Death.
- NPC Dialogue Bug.
- Pressing "Menu Toggle" button when looking at your gear now no longer breaks controller when returning to the Chip Selection.
- Potentially fixed the weapon swap bug... again...

[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]
- Spinners will sometimes go off the map/through walls. If this happens you can Return to Menu (NOT Restart Run) and then Continue Run to be able to continue your run in the same room. Sorry!
- Wide Screen Monitor's not fully supported

notes.title: Patch V0.2.3
notes.content:
[h1]Patch V0.2.3[/h1]

[h2]Minor Changes[/h2]
- Updated Portal Icons to be more consistent with UI Icons.
- Updated Dodge Crystals color to be yellow instead of green.

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- First Boss HP reduced from 85 to 50.
- Two other enemies base damage increased from 5 to 10 to be 10 Damage. Keeping it inline with all other enemy damage.

[b]Developer Note:[/b] My overall goal for boss fights is for them to feel long. But not too long. Due to the immune phases with the first boss the fight tends to take newer players a bit too long to defeat. I've reduced the HP in order to make it feel less like a slog, however pending how Augments pan out, I may increase it again in the future.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Potentially fixed a bug where sometimes your weapon swap wouldn't swap in the HUD. (Would also cause a lot of other issues like menus not working, infinite looping in the hub and more.)
- Actually added the Score modifier based selected difficulty.
- Capped the FPS to 60 FPS.

[b]Developer Note:[/b] There were some reports of peoples GPU's/Computers running hot. I've gone ahead and capped the FPS to 60 as a temporary solution. In the future, I will offer you the user, to cap your FPS, or make it Unlimited, along with a Vsync option. However in the mean time while this is being worked on I've capped the FPS.

[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]
- Wide Screen Monitor's not fully supported.
- Potentially the weapon bug mentioned above.

[b]Developer Note:[/b] If you receive the weapon bug mentioned, please provide me with repo steps if at all possible. It's driving me insane.

notes.title: Patch V0.2.2
notes.content:
[h1]Patch V0.2.2[/h1]

[h2]Features[/h2]
- Difficulty Options
    - New Difficulty Options can be found in the Options Menu.
     - Easy: Enemies deal 50% less Damage and have 50% less HP. Your ending score is reduced by 50%.
     - Medium: Default setting.
     - Hard: Enemies deal 50% more Damage and have 50% More HP. Your ending score is increased by 50%.

[b]Developer Note:[/b] Some of you may ask "Why should I play on X difficulty if all it does is effect my score?". While I know that not everyone likes to chase scores, I felt that for the time being this was the easiest solution while ensuring the game and the story is accessible to everyone while still keeping some challenge.

- Infinite Run Mode unlocks after beating the current last boss when returning the hub.
    - Infinite Run Mode will keep looping the 20 Room Cycle.
   - Every X rooms, enemies will have their HP and Damage Increased.

[b]Developer Note:[/b] In the future, the Infinite Run Mode will be expanded on greatly. We have plans to include a seeded weekly run with an ingame leader board, along with more end game loop options. While that isn't the focus of the playtest, I wanted to say thank you to those that played as much as they did and beat the last boss of the playtest. As such, an Infinite Run Mode is now offered if you wish you keep playing and playtesting.

[h2]Balance[/h2]
- Increased the Proc Coefficient of Bubble Boy from 0.33 to 1.
- Basic Drones will now deal 10 Damage instead of 5 to match everything else in the game for consistency.

[b]Developer Note:[/b] During playtests I realized that the Bubble Boy's low damage values don't benefit as much from % Damage Increase. To compensate, it now has a higher chance to apply Status Effects + Activate Chips. Basic Drones dealing double damage is due to offering newer Difficulty Options.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
- Fixed the "no money" error sound effect following you everywhere.

[h2]Known Bugs[/h2]
- Super Wide Screen Monitors not fully supported.
